test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.

Savita said, “I’m enjoying my stay in the hills.”

options.text: Savita said that she was enjoying her stay in the hills.
Savita said that I am enjoying my stay in the hills.
Savita said that she had been enjoying her stay in the hills.
Savita said that I’m going to enjoy my stay in the hills.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Savita said that she was enjoying her stay in the hills."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The basic rules of these types of questions:
 
 
• If the reported verb is in **Past Tense, the reported speech will change from Present Continuous Tense to Past Continuous Tense.**
 
• Look at some examples:
 
 
• 
 
 
 

 Direct 
 Reported
 
 

 The nurse said to me, “The doctor is calling you.”
 The nurse said to me that the doctor was calling me.
 
 

 The old man said, “I am catching fish.”
 The old man said that he was catching fish.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 
Hence the correct answer is: *Savita said that she was enjoying her stay in the hills.*
